decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the premises shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use and shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 5 - Informative 


This Planning Permission is not for A3 Food and Drink Use. The existing use for the premises entitles you to use it as a sandwich bar or similar use which would compose of :

Sale of sandwiches or other cold food for consumption off the premises.

It does not permit the sale of hot food for consumption off the premises or food and drink to be consumed on the premises.

2) As the proposal involves the preparation of food you will be required to comply with environmental health standards. Please contact the Food Safety Team on 020 8583 5555.

However you should note that your Use will not cease to be considered to be a shop merely because you also sell hot drinks or if a few customers eat on the premises or if you reheat a small proportion of what you sell in a microwave.
